about:
Ocotillo Solar Electric was founded in 2016 in Albuquerque, New Mexico, by Dominic Westeen. The company began as a locally owned and operated residential solar installer with a focus on bringing high-quality, low-cost solar installations and exemplary customer service to homeowners in the Albuquerque metro area and surrounding communities.

The firm specializes in residential solar photovoltaic design, installation, and maintenance, along with off-grid and battery backup system design and installation. It also provides service and repair work for existing PV systems, roof replacement removal and re-installation of solar arrays, third-party design consultation, and EV charger installation. Since 2016 the team has completed hundreds of home installations across New Mexico, and its collective experience exceeds 1,000 systems.

Ocotillo serves residential homeowners in Albuquerque, Rio Rancho, Corrales, Bernalillo, Placitas, Los Lunas, Belen, Tijeras, Cedar Crest, Sandia Park, and the East Mountains. Customers typically seek grid-tied solar arrays, battery storage for backup power, or EV charging infrastructure, and the company manages permitting, utility interconnection, and incentive paperwork on their behalf.

The company emphasizes its local presence, NABCEP-certified leadership, and a community giving program that has donated over $15,000 to nonprofits since 2017. It partners with top-tier distributors to supply modules, inverters, batteries, and EV chargers with industry-leading warranties, aiming to match quality with low-cost installation.
